EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a very strong band at 840 cm⁻¹, characteristic of the ring-breathing mode of para-disubstituted benzene derivatives. Bands at 708 and 645 cm⁻¹ are consistent with aromatic C–Cl stretching/bending, pointing specifically to a chloro-substituted ring. The presence of both aromatic and aliphatic C–H stretches (3022/3073 and 2845/2956 cm⁻¹) matches a benzyl alcohol motif (GFQ-003). The 1622 cm⁻¹ band fits the aromatic C=C stretch, and a band at 1036 cm⁻¹ plausibly corresponds to a C–O stretch of the benzylic alcohol. Among the candidates, only OCc1ccc(Cl)cc1 (index 2) has the required para-disubstituted benzene with chlorine and a benzylic alcohol, matching the observed features.
